irish_potato.integrity_policy: ALL_THREE_PROVIDER_ARCHIVES_MUST_PASS_PROVIDER_CHECKSUM_AND_DECLARED_BYTE_SIZE; LOGICAL IMAGE SUPPORT IS DEFINED BY UNIQUE PUBLISHED IMAGE FILENAME; DUPLICATE ARCHIVE COPIES MAY BE COLLAPSED ONLY WHEN ALL COPIES WITH THE SAME CASEFOLDED BASENAME ARE BYTE-IDENTICAL; CONFLICTING DUPLICATES FAIL CLOSED

notes: This lock is operational/provenance hardening only and does not change frozen Track-B scientific thresholds, mappings, seeds or evidence-grade rules.

The Scientific Data article names docs/checksums.txt; the official companion repository at the pinned commit publishes docs/checksums.csv. Independent verification established exactly 3477 valid SHA-256 rows with complete one-to-one image-path coverage.

Mendeley v5 remains the DOI/version/stable-manifest source identity authority. If its transport object yields zero usable images, image bytes may be materialized from the authors' exact pinned official companion commit; acceptance still requires complete 3477-image SHA-256 verification against the vendored pinned ledger.
The fallback uses a public commit-addressed GitHub codeload transport and requires no GitHub credential; a transport/network failure remains fail-closed.

Irish Potato Zenodo archives are provider-checksum-bound. The published post-preprocessing class counts are 17772/20438/20499. Archive-level duplicate copies may be collapsed only by unique published filename and only when duplicate bytes are identical; conflicting copies remain fail-closed.
